title: Work-tape movement action
statement: For an $m$-work-tape machine, a work-tape index $r$, input-head movement $a$, work-tape movement $b$, and state $s$, define an action that attempts movement $a$ on the input head, makes no writes on any work tape, moves tape $r$ by $b$ and leaves the other work-tape heads stationary, emits no output symbol, and enters state $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ of work tapes
